title: ALMA Observations of the Young Substellar Binary System 2M1207
question: Do the brown dwarf 2M1207A and its planetary-mass companion 2M1207b host dust and gas disks, and what are their sizes and masses?

evidence.loc: 4 Analysis of the dust continuum emission
evidence.quote: dust opacity $\kappa_{\nu} = 3.4$ cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ at a frequency of 338 GHz (cite: Beckwith:1990)

evidence.loc: 4 Analysis of the dust continuum emission
4 Analysis of the dust continuum emission

recipe.method: clean imaging and imfit Gaussian fit; upper limit at 2M1207b from 3 sigma assuming point source
Optically thin M=F d^2/(kappa B(T)); optically thick limit gives radius limit
assumptions: d = 52.8 pc, kappa = 3.4 cm2/g at 338 GHz

recipe.goal: Fit CO visibilities for disk structure and dynamical mass
recipe.method: Parametric disk model, RADMC-3D channel maps sampled at the uv positions, chi2 fit in visibility space
Monte Carlo of truncation radius from projected separation and mass ratio, using Artymowicz & Lubow fits for alpha 0.1-0.0001, uniform orbital priors
assumptions: 2M1207b orbit possibly in the disk plane

evidence.quote: The flux density from the disk is $620 \pm 67$ $\mu$Jy
The $3\sigma$ upper limit for the flux density at 0.89 mm is 78 $\mu$Jy
velocity-integrated total flux of $71.0 \pm 8.4$ mJy km s$^{-1}$

evidence.loc: 4 Analysis of the dust continuum emission

evidence.quote: the dust mass for the detected 2M1207A disk is $M_{\rm{dust},\rm{2MA}} \approx 0.1~M_\oplus$
we derived an estimate of $42^{+19}_{-2}$ au for the current separation

not_stated_but_needed: Image size, cell size, clean threshold and masks
Velocity range/channel selection used for the CO moment 0 map and the fitted visibilities
Stellar and disk parameters (e.g. fixed outer radius, scale height) in the DiskJockey runs
MCMC priors on parameters other than gamma_e and q

score_reason: Public data and simple analysis, but imaging and modeling settings are incompletely given.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, a numeric continuum flux and mass limits are reproducible; the CO model is partly specified.
